idea-plugin.name: TODO++
idea-plugin.description:
Turbocharge Your TODOs with TODO++

TODO++ (Todo Plus) transforms standard TODO comments into an intelligent, AI-augmented task management system directly within all JetBrains IDEs. Organize, track, export, and complete tasks without leaving your code.

✨ Status: v2.4.0

🔥 Key Features:

  • 🤖 AI-Powered Jira Ticket Assistant: Analyze unlinked/forgotten TODO comments with surrounding code context (±15 lines) using Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or Ollama. Review, draft, and create Jira tickets with 1-click in-place code linking (// TODO(issue:KEY): ...).
  • 🛡️ VCS Pre-Commit Guard: Automatically detects unlinked TODO comments in staged Git files and alerts you before committing, preventing forgotten tasks from crossing sprints.
  • 🔄 Real-Time Centralized Cache & Single-Flight Scan: Sub-10ms incremental rescanning during editor typing. Coalesced background tasks eliminate redundant scans and multiple progress bars.
  • 🌐 REST Integration (GitHub & Jira): Direct 1-click export of any TODO comment to GitHub Issues or Jira Cloud with formatted markdown details.
  • 🔔 Slack & Discord Webhooks: Dispatch instant overdue task alerts directly into team communication channels via webhooks.
  • Multi-Selection & Batch Completion: Select multiple TODO items or group headers and toggle completion in batch!
  • Executive PDF & HTML Reports: Export formatted, printable reports with priority breakdown charts.
  • Entire Solution & Cross-IDE Support: Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, CLion, Rider, Android Studio, and RustRover.
  • Zero Deprecated APIs & Dynamic Reload: 100% compliant with IntelliJ Platform 2024.1+; install and update without restarting your IDE.

📝 Usage Examples:

// TODO(@john priority:critical due:today): Fix production crash
// TODO(issue:PROJ-101): Refactor authentication handler
# BUG(issue:#42 priority:high): Fix memory leak in background worker
// HACK(@alice priority:medium): Temporary workaround for layout issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v2.4.0 Release Notes:

  • 🤖 AI-Powered Jira Ticket Assistant: Integration with Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Ollama/Local models to turn unlinked TODO comments into complete Jira tickets with automated in-place code linking.
  • 🛡️ VCS Pre-Commit Check: Warns developers during Git commit when unlinked TODOs are staged to prevent orphan tasks from escaping into production.
  • 🔄 Real-Time Centralized Sync: Incremental file scanning with MessageBus sync across all open tool windows. Single-flight task coalescer prevents redundant background scans.
  • 🎨 Settings UI Form Improvements: Robust responsive GridBagLayout form layout preventing UI displacement when pasting long API tokens.
  • ⚡ 100% Verified Clean Platform APIs: Verified against IntelliJ 2024.1, 2024.2, and 2024.3 with zero deprecated API warnings and dynamic plugin reload eligibility.

v2.3.0 Release Notes:

  • GitHub Issues REST Export: 1-click export of any TODO directly to GitHub Issues via REST API.
  • Jira Cloud REST Export: Export tasks directly into Jira Cloud projects.
  • Slack & Discord Webhook Alerts: Send overdue task summaries directly to Slack channels and Discord servers.
  • Performance at Scale: Optimized virtualized tree expansion and 200ms debounce for 5,000+ items.

v2.1.0 Release Notes:

  • Block Comment TODO Detection: TODOs inside /* TODO: ... */ and mid-line comments detected across all languages.
  • Javadoc / KDoc Support: /** TODO: ... */ style comments scanned.
  • Customisable HTML Export: Override styling, stats, list/table sections, and footer from Settings.
  • Priority Urgency Ordering: Tree groups ordered by urgency (Critical → High → Medium → Low).
  • Large File Safety Guard: Files over 5MB skipped to prevent memory pressure.
